subject: Vendr: Evidence POAM & ownership / presign upload questions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@brightleaf.ai>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr: Evidence POAM & ownership / presign upload questions

Hi Lina / Vendr team,

Thanks for taking this through — we want to get BrightLeaf's security profile updated in Vendr and finish proof ingestion for the SOC 2 artifacts. A couple of asks to make the upload and review straightforward: 

1) Evidence manifest: can you provide a short CSV that lists S3 keys (or presigned paths), control mapping (SOC2 control ID), and a simple proof-of-possession hash or signed URL? We like a single manifest so our reviewers can trace items.

2) POAM (Plan of Action & Milestones): BrightLeaf noted ~4 outstanding remediation items during the last assessment. We need a POAM CSV (title, impacted control, status, owner, target_date) so we can include it in the vendor profile.

3) Upload mechanism: do you support presigned S3 uploads or do you require SFTP/portal push? If presigned, what expiry window do you recommend (we typically do 1 hour presigns for bulk ingestion). If you prefer portal push, confirm max file size per object.

4) Ownership / proof-of-possession: for any S3 evidence, we ask that the object metadata include an uploader-email and a manifest reference (manifest_row_id). If Vendr needs an alternate assertion (signed manifest, in-portal attestations), tell us and we'll adapt.

5) Timing: we want to schedule a 30-min sync this week to confirm the manifest mapping and POAM format. Availability: Nov 2-3, 10:00-15:00 PT.

I've attached our vendor upload checklist and a blank evidence manifest template to speed things up.

Next steps: please reply with preferred upload method, POAM template, and one proposed sync slot.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments:
- vendr_upload_instructions.pdf (1 page, presign instructions + required metadata)
- evidence_manifest_template.csv (columns: row_id, file_name, s3_key_or_url, control_id, proof_hash, notes)

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@brightleaf.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr: Evidence POAM & ownership / presign upload questions

Hi Jordan,

Appreciate the clear checklist — this is helpful. Quick answers: 

- We can do presigned S3 uploads to our ingestion bucket (s3://brightleaf-evidence-ingest). 1 hour expiry for presigns works for us.
- We will prepare a manifest with control mappings and include an SHA256 hash in the proof_hash column.
- For POAM, we can export a CSV from our internal tracker; I can attach a sample.
- Question: do you require object-level metadata to contain uploader-email, or is the manifest row sufficient for your reviewers? We can add metadata but prefer manifest linkage to avoid duplication.

I'll coordinate with Vendr support on the presign endpoint (cc'd). If Vendr needs a special filename pattern or folder layout they can let us know.

Propose a sync: Nov 2 at 11:00 PT. Does that work?

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Head of Security Operations, BrightLeaf AI
lina.gomez@brightleaf.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@brightleaf.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr: Evidence POAM & ownership / presign upload questions

Hi Lina — thanks, that schedule works for Jordan and me. A few clarifications from our side to reduce back-and-forth during ingestion: 

- Preferred presign policy: 1 hour expiry, single object presigns (we will issue per-row). Please put objects under prefix: brightleaf/{manifest_row_id}/<filename>. That structure makes automated mapping painless.

- Metadata vs manifest: manifest is fine as the primary mapping. If you add object metadata uploader-email that’s an acceptable bonus but not required. The required fields in the manifest we will validate are: row_id, filename, s3_key, control_id, sha256, uploaded_by, upload_timestamp.

- POAM format: we attached a quick POAM sample (poam_sample.csv) — fields: poam_id, summary, control_id, status [open,in_progress,monitoring,closed], owner_email, target_date, notes. Please use the status vocabulary above so our ingestion maps correctly.

- Compliance review window: once files are in the ingest bucket, our automated scans will run and flag missing control mappings within 2 business days. If anything is flagged as 'missing proof', we will open a HubSpot task against deal HS-97431 and loop you in.

- Security note: if you need temporary credentials instead of presigned URLs, we can provide a constrained IAM role with PutObject-only and a short expiry via our SSO. However, presigns are preferred for auditability.

Link to our internal upload runbook (for Vendr): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-runbook-id — it includes sample cURL and a Python presign helper.

I'll attach the POAM sample to this message. Jordan — can you add the HubSpot ticket link in the sync invite?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Enablement | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- poam_sample.csv

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@brightleaf.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendr Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr: Evidence POAM & ownership / presign upload questions

Marissa / Jordan,

Thanks — we confirmed internally and will proceed with presigned uploads under the prefix you specified. A couple quick items before the sync: 

- We created an initial manifest (attached) with ~120 objects; a few larger logs will be uploaded separately.
- We'd like to mark POAM statuses as either "in_progress" or "monitoring" where appropriate — is that acceptable? Your sample has "in_progress" which matches our tracker.

We booked the 30-minute sync for Nov 6, 14:00 PT and invited Jordan/Marissa. Vendr support said they will enable the presign endpoint and provide a short test key tomorrow morning.

One small ask: for any flagged items during automated scan, please include an example expected evidence (e.g., snippet of config file or specific log filename) in the HubSpot task so we can close items faster.

Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Lina
